# Introduction

-   回去翻過去 EDP 的實驗資料分析有個奇怪的地方，就是發現不少違反 monotonicity 的受試者

    -  bisection method 決定boundary的方法之一就是採用monotonicity，因此不應該發生這件事。
    
-   重看當時的實驗程式，發現當時的做法和A學者所提Bisection不同，並沒有紀錄upper/lower bound再取中點，而是先用equal expectation決定初始值，直接以初始值的絕對值* 1/2 當作一開始的step size，之後的step size就一直折半下去。

    -  姑且先稱作simplified Bisection (不用modified 是怕跟MOBS搞混)，取`SimpBisection`
    
-   EDP 當時測的樣本點比Abdellaoui et al. (2016) 年的多，收到 $x_8^+, x_8^-$，且 Iteration = 5。


## Directories

```{r dir_params}
dir_name <- here::here("data")
```


# Violations of Monotonicity

-   EDP stage 1 的違反比率非常高(20/87, 若只考慮到$x_6^+, x_6^-$, 則(14/87))。
    
    -  有一可能也是我們測的樣本點太多。

-   但 simplified Bisection 除了$\phi$ small 時特別高，其他都在3%以下。
    
    -   另外違反率大小在目前設定下看起來跟$\lambda$ (i.e., value function)沒有關係，只跟 $\phi$ 有關係。
    
    -   從模型角度來看就是因為我們收的受試者選擇較隨機 ($\phi$較小)而非其他緣故

## Read Data and Violations of Monotonicity

```{r message=FALSE}
util.levels <- c(
  paste0("x", 8:1, "neg"),
  paste0("x", 1:8, "pos")
)

EDP_rawdata <- read_csv(here::here("data", "EDP_stage1_rawdata.csv"))

EDP_rawdata %>% 
  relocate(util.levels, .after = subject) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    violation = is.unsorted(c_across(x8neg:x8pos)),
    violation.6 = is.unsorted(c_across(x6neg:x6pos)), # keep from x_6- to x_6+ only
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(
    violation_ratio = glue("{round(sum(violation)/n(), 2) * 100}%"),
    violation.6_ratio = glue("{round(sum(violation.6)/n(), 2)*100}%"), 
    violation_count = sum(violation),
    violation.6_count = sum(violation.6),
    n = n()
  )
```

-   過去研究中資料違反 monotonicity 的比率 (兩者皆使用 3+1 次 iterations 的bisection-slider法)

    -   Abdellaoui et al. (2016) 違monotonicity比例(3/75 = `r round(3/75, 3)`)

    -   Bleichrod and L’Haridon (2023) 違反monotonicity比例(10/122 = `r round(10/122, 3)`)


## Loss Aversion Coefficients

```{r}
EDP_nestdata <- EDP_rawdata %>% 
  relocate(util.levels, .after = subject) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    violation.6 = is.unsorted(c_across(x6neg:x6pos)), # keep from x_6- to x_6+ only
    ) %>%
  ungroup()

EDP_nestdata <- EDP_nestdata %>% 
  mutate(KW = - x1pos / x1neg) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches(".*[1-6][pos|neg]"), # keep x1 - x6 only
                 names_to = c("trial", "type"),
                 names_pattern = "x(\\d)(.*)",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    trial = as.integer(trial),
    type = ifelse(type == "pos", "gain", "loss")  # Assign gain/loss
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value) %>%
  select(!x8neg:beta) %>% 
  nest(data = c(trial, gain, loss))
```


```{r}
EDP_LA_data <- EDP_nestdata %>% 
  mutate(
    KT = map(data, ~ KT2(.x)),
    KW_classification = case_when(
      KW > 1 ~ "averse",
      KW == 1 ~ "neutral",
      KW < 1 ~ "seeking"
    ),
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(KT, names_sep = "_") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(KW, KT_mean, KT_median),
               names_to = "LA_type",
               values_to = "LA_est") %>% 
  mutate(Classification = if_else(LA_type %in% c("KT_mean", "KT_median"), 
                                  KT_classification, 
                                  KW_classification)) %>% 
  select(!c(matches("*_classification"), data))
```


- `KT` 分類的方式是 $\frac{-U(-x_i^+)}{U(x_i^+)}>1, \frac{U(x_i^-)}{-U(-x_i^-)}>1$ 的比例多於一半 

-   `KT` 係數的估計上，A學者2016和 Bleichrod and L’Haridon (2023)最後的報表似乎只報告`KT_median`，見下圖。

### 剔除違反monotonicity
```{r}
EDP_LA_result.Monotone_only <- EDP_LA_data %>%
  filter(!violation.6) %>% 
  group_by(LA_type) %>% 
  summarise(
    Median_IQR = glue("{quantile(LA_est, .50) |> round(2)} [{round(quantile(LA_est, .25),2)} - {round(quantile(LA_est, .75),2)}]"),
    Averse = sum(Classification == "averse"),
    Seeking = sum(Classification == "seeking"),
    Neutral = sum(Classification == "neutral")
)
# kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Loss Aversion Coefficients",
# format = "latex")
EDP_LA_result.Monotone_only
```

### 保留違反monotonicity
```{r}
EDP_LA_result <- EDP_LA_data %>%
  group_by(LA_type) %>% 
  summarise(
    # LA_median = quantile(LA_est, .50) |> round(2),
    Median_IQR = glue("{quantile(LA_est, .50) |> round(2)}[{round(quantile(LA_est, .25),2)} - {round(quantile(LA_est, .75),2)}]"),
    Averse = sum(Classification == "averse"),
    Seeking = sum(Classification == "seeking"),
    Neutral = sum(Classification == "neutral")
)

EDP_LA_result %>% 
  xtable::xtable()
```

兩表沒有相差太多，正式報告時應該保留前者就好。

```{r}
past_studies <- tribble(
  ~research, ~LA_type, ~Averse, ~Seeking, ~Neutral,
  "A2016",   "KT",   58,    10, 1,
  "A2016",   "KW",   56,    14, 1,
  "BL2023", "KT",    73,    39, 3,
  "BL2023", "KW",    73,    35, 14
)

research_summ <- EDP_LA_result %>% 
  add_column(research = "EDP") %>%
  bind_rows(EDP_LA_result.Monotone_only |>
              add_column(research = "EDP_monotone")
            ) %>% 
  bind_rows(past_studies) %>% 
  filter(!LA_type == "KT_mean") %>% 
  select(!Median_IQR) %>% 
  mutate(LA_type = case_when(LA_type == "KT_median" ~  "KT",
                             TRUE ~ LA_type),
         nAverse = Seeking + Neutral,
         .after = Averse,
        .keep = "unused")


KT_mtx <- research_summ %>%
  filter(LA_type == "KT") %>% 
  select(research, Averse, nAverse) %>%  # Keep relevant columns
  column_to_rownames(var = "research") %>%  # Set research as row names
  as.matrix()

KW_mtx <- research_summ %>%
  filter(LA_type == "KW") %>% 
  select(research, Averse, nAverse) %>%  # Keep relevant columns
  column_to_rownames(var = "research") %>%  # Set research as row names
  as.matrix()

# Chi-squared test
## All EDP data

for (exclude in c("EDP", "EDP_monotone")) {
  for (name in c("KT", "KW")) {
    mtx <- get(paste0(name, "_mtx"))
    
    filtered_mtx <- mtx[rownames(mtx) != exclude, ]
    
    aa <- if (exclude == "EDP") "EDP exclude violations of Monotonicity." else "All EDP data."
    cat("=== Index:", name, " | Data:", aa, "===\n")
    print(chisq.test(filtered_mtx))
    cat("N =", sum(filtered_mtx), "\n\n")
  }
}

```


```{r}
# num of all obs (keep monotone only)
research_summ %>% 
  filter(research != "EDP") %>% 
  group_by(LA_type) %>% 
  summarise(N = sum(Averse, nAverse))

# num of all obs (all EDP data)
research_summ %>% 
  filter(research != "EDP_monotone") %>% 
  group_by(LA_type) %>% 
  summarise(N = sum(Averse, nAverse))
```



-   可以發現在分類上EDP資料裡seeking 的比例比兩個這兩個實驗較多，而loss aversion 係數估計上比較靠近2023的結果。

use `ggmatrix` instead


```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
EDP_LA_data %>% 
  select(!Classification) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = LA_type,
    values_from = LA_est
              ) %>% 
  filter(!violation.6) %>%
  select(KW:KT_median) %>% 
  GGally::ggpairs(
    diag = list(
      continuous =
        GGally::wrap("barDiag", fill= "grey50", color = "black", bins= 25)
      ),
    lower = list(
      continuous =
        GGally::wrap("points", fill= "grey50", color = "black", alpha = 0.4)
      ),
    upper = list(
    continuous = function(data, mapping, ...) {
      GGally::ggally_cor(data, mapping, method = "kendall", 
                 title = "Kendall")
    }
  )
  ) + 
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Correlations b/t Loss Aversion Coefficients")

ggsave("LAcompare_Corr.pdf", width = 6, height = 6, units = "in")
```



## 和 Study 2 其他方法間比較

-   模擬顯示，Simplified-Bisection 在 $\phi$ small 時的違反monotonicity比率甚至比PEST還要誇張。

-   這也能部份解釋 EDP 當時違反monotonicity的情況很嚴重，代表此方法容易導致違反monotonicity。

# 小節

-   EDP 中 simplified Bisection 法在受試者選擇較一致時與Bisection法的表現差不多，但是在 $\phi$ 很小的時候表現非常差。
  
    -   RMSE 較大(在gain frame)，且違反monotonicity的比例較高。

-   在 EDP 實驗中產生比較多違反monotonicity的受試者，可能的解釋之一是有許多受試者選擇隨機性較高。
    
    -   違反monotonicity如果只和 $\phi$ 有關而和value function無關，或許可以從這方面去推估實驗$\phi$的數值。
